description: This file defines the 'GrainReferenceNotBoundException' class used to signal that a GrainReference was not properly bound before use in the Orleans runtime. It includes multiple constructors and serialization support.

classes.name: GrainReferenceNotBoundException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating an unbound GrainReference in Orleans runtime.

methods.name: GrainReferenceNotBoundException(GrainReference)
methods.description: Constructs the exception with a message indicating the GrainReference was not bound.

methods.name: GrainReferenceNotBoundException(string)
methods.description: Constructs the exception with a specified message.

methods.name: GrainReferenceNotBoundException(string, Exception)
methods.description: Constructs the exception with a message and inner exception.

methods.name: GrainReferenceNotBoundException(SerializationInfo, StreamingContext)
methods.description: Serialization constructor marked as Obsolete, used during deserialization.
